summary: Successfully implemented KAFKA-13499 to avoid restoring outdated records by using timestamp-based seeking for windowed stores without checkpoints. The implementation adds a retentionPeriod field to StateStoreMetadata and implements timestamp-based seeking logic in StoreChangelogReader.prepareChangelogs() and seekByTimestampForWindowedStores(). All 45 tests in StoreChangelogReaderTest pass, including the three new tests for this feature.
